apps.name: OmaRaptor Player
apps.short: YouTube video player for Omarchy and Linux.
apps.tagline: YouTube video player for Omarchy and Linux
apps.lede: A free, open-source, super-light player for almost any video link. Copy a link, press Super+Alt+Y, and it plays in a pinned 16:9 window. No login, no browser, and a HUD inspired by the F-22 Raptor.

seo.title: OmaRaptor Player: YouTube video player for Omarchy and Linux
seo.description: OmaRaptor Player is a free, open-source YouTube video player for Omarchy and Linux. It plays YouTube, X, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram and live streams in a light mpv window, with no login and an HUD inspired by the F-22 Raptor.
seo.keywords: YouTube player, video player, YouTube video player for Linux, YouTube video player for Omarchy, Omarchy, Hyprland, mpv, yt-dlp

features: Copy a link, press Super+Alt+Y. The first player opens centred, more players park in the free corners.
A bare player with a slim bar, or the full cockpit. MASTER ARM switches between them.
Seek tape, time, volume, speed, repeat, link status and a real audio signal meter.
Heading tape, VOL and REM tapes, a top time box and a scope that locks on when you pause.
Timers turn amber, then red, and a NEXT card shows what plays next.
No login and no browser. mpv and yt-dlp underneath, so it starts fast and stays light.

chips.title: SUPPORTED SITES
chips.note: Vimeo and Reddit don't work, because they need a login.

apps.installNote: Needs mpv, yt-dlp, socat, jq and wl-clipboard. The installer asks before it adds one line to your Hyprland config. ./uninstall.sh removes it all.
fine: Footage in the screen recording and screenshots: “F-22 Demo Team performs for 2026 Cleveland Air Show”, U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. Mary Bowers (DVIDS 1023319), public domain. The appearance of U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) visual information does not imply or constitute DoD endorsement.
Recorded in the real OmaRaptor Player (mpv with the OmaRaptor HUD) on Linux. Muted on this page.
Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Air Force, Lockheed Martin, SpaceX or NASA.

shots.alt: OmaRaptor Player fullscreen: the reticle locks on an F-22 Raptor filling the frame, with the full cockpit HUD, title ticker, heading tape, volume and remaining-time tapes, the control bar and the live audio meter.

OmaRaptor Player playing an F-22 Raptor air show pass: the neon title ticker, the live audio meter, volume, seek tape with elapsed and remaining time, the progress ring, speed, repeat and link gauges.
The OmaRaptor launch console after FIRE: a 3 counts down over the preloaded F-22 frame, MASTER ARM ON, SEEKER LOCK, signal and buffer bars, and the link below.
The first second of playback: the OmaRaptor reticle locks on the F-22 as the picture fills the window and the control bar comes up.
A second OmaRaptor window opened with + over a playing F-22 flight: the new window waits on NO SIGNAL with PASTE LINK while the parent keeps playing under the HUD and live audio meter.
The OmaRaptor keyboard panel opened with ? over F-22 playback, listing the player's keys while the HUD gauges and live audio meter keep running.

apps.name: Oma Year Planner
apps.short: Your whole year on one screen. A local-first year calendar for Omarchy.
apps.tagline: Your whole year on one screen
apps.lede: A local-first year calendar for Omarchy, with no backend, no account and no build step. Add plans, filter the year by name, and float it as a translucent window over your desktop.

seo.title: Oma Year Planner: a local-first year calendar for Omarchy
seo.description: Oma Year Planner puts your whole year on one screen. A free, open-source, local-first year calendar plugin for Omarchy, with no backend, no account and no tracking.
seo.keywords: year planner, year calendar, Omarchy plugin, Omarchy, Hyprland, local-first calendar, Linux calendar

features: Months run down one scrolling board. The day header stays pinned, and Today brings the current month back to the middle.
Past months and finished plans dim, so what is ahead stands out.
Click a day, name the plan, pick Plan or Trip. Drag a bar to move it, or drag its ends to resize it.
Trips add up to a days-away count per month and for the year. Next, Up next and Last sit on the strip.
A still picture of your year laid over your wallpaper, painted again at midnight.
Reads the colours from your active Omarchy theme each time it opens.
Plans stay in your browser. No server, no account, no analytics and no tracking.
Search with /, undo with Ctrl+Z, and full keyboard navigation. Press ? for the list.
apps.installNote: The plugin adds a calendar button to your bar. You need Chromium (it ships with Omarchy), Python 3 and curl, plus ImageMagick for wallpaper mode.
fine: All plans in these screenshots are the planner's built-in demo year. Captured in a sandbox browser from the public repo at bd1c117.
The floating-window shot draws the window at 86% opacity over a plain generated backdrop, the way a translucent Hyprland window looks.

shots.alt: Oma Year Planner with the full 2026 year on one board: the built-in demo plans Ski week, City break, Wedding weekend, Workshop, Coast week, Lake week, Autumn hike and Year-end break, with plans, trips and days-away counts on the strip and today marked in October.
The quick add popover opened on November 12 in the demo year, with an empty name field, Add plan, Attach photo, Add tag, Plan or Trip and Add note.
The How it works panel opened with ?, showing add a plan, one day, move and resize, quick edit, scroll months and jump to today, plus the keyboard shortcuts.
Oma Year Planner as a translucent floating window over a plain green desktop backdrop, showing the demo plans from April 2026 into 2027.

apps.name: Kar Page
apps.short: Your cars. Your story. A web app for car enthusiasts.
apps.lede: An app for car enthusiasts to show off their cars and connect with like-minded people around the world.

seo.title: Kar Page: your cars, your story
seo.description: Kar Page is a web app for car enthusiasts to show off their cars and connect with like-minded people around the world.
seo.keywords: Kar Page, car enthusiasts, car community, cars, karpage.app

features: A place for car enthusiasts to show the cars they love.
Meet like-minded people from around the world.
A web app at karpage.app. Nothing to install.
Want it as a desktop app? The Kar Page Launcher opens it in its own window.
apps.embedLine: A web app for car enthusiasts.

cards: Tap ⋯, then Share (or just Share, depending on your tab layout).
Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen. Keep Open as Web App on.
Tap Install app (Install and create shortcut, or Add to home screen, on some versions).
Click the Install icon in the address bar (Chrome also has ⋮ › Cast, save, and share › Install page as app).
On Omarchy, use Kar Page Launcher below.
pwa.note: Kar Page is a web app (PWA): once added, it opens from its own icon, full screen, like an app.

related: Kar Page Launcher adds Kar Page to your launcher as its own app window.
fine: The frame shows the public karpage.app homepage, live. Signing in works best in the full app.

shots.alt: Kar Page grid scan, a public browse screen for spots and cars. No one is signed in.

apps.name: Kar Page Launcher
apps.short: Kar Page as a desktop app on Omarchy, in its own Chromium app window.
apps.tagline: Kar Page as a desktop app on Omarchy
apps.lede: It adds a launcher entry and an icon, and opens karpage.app in its own Chromium app window. The install script is short and readable, and the command opens it in less before it runs.

seo.title: Kar Page Launcher: Kar Page as a desktop app on Omarchy
seo.description: Kar Page Launcher adds Kar Page to the Omarchy launcher with an icon, and opens karpage.app in its own Chromium app window. No sudo, no network, no packages.
seo.keywords: Kar Page, Omarchy launcher, Omarchy app, Chromium app window, Hyprland

features: Copies a launcher entry and an icon into your home folder. That is the whole install.
Opens karpage.app in its own Chromium app window, sized like a phone.
No sudo, no network and no packages. If Chromium is missing it stops and says how to get it.
less shows the install script before it runs. Press q to install, or Ctrl-C to stop.
install: git clone https://github.com/KarPage/karpage-omarchy.git && cd karpage-omarchy && less install && ./install
apps.installNote: The window uses the same Chromium profile as the browser, so a Kar Page sign-in is shared. ./uninstall removes the two files.
fine: The launcher is MIT licensed. The Kar Page app itself is a private codebase and is not in this repo.

apps.name: OmaKarDash
apps.short: A Tesla dashboard for Omarchy. Coming soon.
apps.lede: A Tesla dashboard for Omarchy: charge and range, climate, tires, lock state and software updates. Not released yet. Every screen here uses demo data for a fictional car.

seo.title: OmaKarDash: a Tesla dashboard for Omarchy (coming soon)
seo.description: OmaKarDash is a coming-soon Tesla dashboard for Omarchy: charge and range, climate, tires, lock state and software updates. Unofficial, not affiliated with Tesla.
seo.keywords: Omarchy, Tesla dashboard, Linux car dashboard, Hyprland, OmaKarDash

features: Battery level, range and charging state at a glance.
Cabin temperature, climate state and the pressure of each tire.
Lock state and pending software updates.
Reads cached data without waking the car.
A confirm on every command. No unlock, no location and no remote start.
Uses each owner's own Tesla developer app.
apps.soon: OmaKarDash is not released yet. There is no download and no source link for now.
fine: Screenshots use demo data for the fictional car Northwind.
Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Tesla.
